name: Explained document proofreading

baseline.Scope: One English document, up to 2,000 words
baseline.Deliverable: Edited document and an original/revised comparison
baseline.Tone: Preserve intended author tone; target promise, not measured performance
baseline.Method: AI-assisted editing; no human editor promised
baseline.Exclusions: No factual verification, citation verification, plagiarism certification, or subject-matter review

standout: An edit ledger explains each substantive change and distinguishes necessary corrections from optional style changes.
selling_point: Understand every meaningful edit. Keep control of your voice.

negative_features.feature: $20 for each document; no unlimited-document plan
negative_features.comparison: Scribbr AI advertises $9.95 for one month of unlimited documents; Grammarly and QuillBot also have free basic alternatives.
negative_features.reason: Deliberate recurring-cost disadvantage; keep rather than automatically improve the offer.

negative_features.comparison: Scribbr AI advertises at most ten minutes; free interactive correction tools are additional substitutes.
negative_features.reason: Deliberate delay to test whether explained edits justify waiting.

design_notes: Selected paid monthly-tool median is $19.95/month ($9.95, $19.95, $30). It cannot be relabeled $20/document. Common correction features form the baseline; the chosen billing unit and wait are explicit deviations. Document cap, file handling, and edit-ledger specifications are design choices.
price_description: $20 per document, one-time; retained proposed test price, NOT a computed median
research_question: Which purchasing situations prefer this offer over alternatives, and does the marketed feature compensate for the deliberate tradeoffs?
experiments: Same offer with versus without marketed standout
Compare by segment without predetermining launch outcome
